description:
Read completed trades from a Sleeper league and identify the highest-value players currently unrostered.
USE WHEN: the user asks what their league has paid, wants recent trade history, waiver targets, or replacement-level context.
Read-only: nothing is posted to Sleeper.

format.description: Value set to use. Default 'dynasty'. IMPORTANT: there is exactly ONE dynasty table and its QB values are superflex/market-weighted — dynasty values are not split by 1QB vs superflex or by scoring. The redraft sets ARE split: redraft-{sf,1qb}-{ppr,half,std}.

week.description: One NFL week. Omit to scan weeks 1–18.
